svg.title: Full Client Engagement Workflow v4
svg.desc: End-to-end flow from pricing page through 3-step onboarding, synchronous backend (CosmosDB, Storage Queue, immediate welcome email), async worker (LLM → pptx → Blob → follow-up email), and admin status chain. Internal notification goes to sales@terian-services.com.
svg.text: Personalized for org · tier · use case
Review requests · move status · trigger proposal flow
Email #2 (PPTX attached) → sent by async worker, typically within 1–3 min of submission
